scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:prod: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/fitness-temple run build
scripts.restart: pnpm run build:prod && pm2 restart fitness-temple --update-env
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
